articles.title: Authorization conditions
articles.requirement: Insurance/reinsurance undertakings must obtain authorization — business plan, minimum capital, fit and proper management, governance

articles.title: Qualifying holdings
articles.requirement: Proposed acquisitions or increases of qualifying holdings require supervisory notification and assessment of acquirer's suitability

articles.title: General governance requirements
articles.requirement: Effective system of governance with clear allocation of responsibilities, fit and proper persons, four key functions

articles.title: Fit and proper requirements
articles.requirement: All persons who effectively run the undertaking or hold key functions must be fit and proper — qualifications, knowledge, experience, reputation

articles.title: Risk management system
articles.requirement: Effective risk management system — strategies, processes, procedures to identify, measure, monitor, manage risks on continuous basis

articles.title: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA)
articles.requirement: Undertakings shall conduct ORSA — assess overall solvency needs, compliance with capital requirements, and significance of deviation from technical provisions assumptions

articles.title: Internal control system
articles.requirement: Effective internal control system including administrative and accounting procedures and an internal control framework

articles.title: Internal audit function
articles.requirement: Effective internal audit function — evaluate adequacy and effectiveness of internal control system and other governance elements

articles.title: Actuarial function
articles.requirement: Effective actuarial function — coordinate calculation of technical provisions, assess sufficiency and quality of data, compare assumptions against experience

articles.title: Outsourcing requirements
articles.requirement: Outsourcing critical or important functions shall not materially impair quality of governance, unduly increase operational risk, or impair supervision

articles.title: Valuation of assets and liabilities
articles.requirement: Assets valued at amounts for which they could be exchanged; liabilities at amounts for which they could be transferred — fair value hierarchy

articles.title: Technical provisions — general rules
articles.requirement: Technical provisions correspond to current amount to transfer insurance obligations to another undertaking — best estimate + risk margin

articles.title: Best estimate calculation
articles.requirement: Best estimate corresponds to probability-weighted average of future cash flows using relevant risk-free yield curve — gross of reinsurance

articles.title: Assumptions underlying technical provisions
articles.requirement: Assumptions shall be realistic, based on credible information — biometric, expense, claims, lapse, future management actions, policyholder behaviour

articles.title: Solvency Capital Requirement (SCR)
articles.requirement: SCR calibrated to ensure 99.5% VaR over one year — all quantifiable risks, calculated at least annually, standard formula or internal model

articles.title: SCR calculation — standard formula
articles.requirement: Standard formula SCR = BSCR + Adj + SCR_op — aggregation using correlation matrices, 6 risk modules

articles.title: SCR risk modules
articles.requirement: Standard formula risk modules: market risk, counterparty default, life underwriting, health underwriting, non-life underwriting — each with sub-modules

articles.title: Internal model — use test
articles.requirement: Internal model approval requires demonstrated use in risk management and decision-making (use test) — not just for regulatory calculation

articles.title: Internal model — validation standards
articles.requirement: Regular cycle of model validation — monitoring performance, review ongoing appropriateness, testing results against experience

articles.title: Minimum Capital Requirement (MCR)
articles.requirement: MCR calculated quarterly using linear formula — absolute floor, cap and floor relative to SCR (25-45%), ladder of intervention

articles.title: Prudent person principle — investments
articles.requirement: Assets invested in accordance with prudent person principle — security, quality, liquidity, profitability, proper diversification, ALM

articles.title: Supervisory reporting (Pillar 3)
articles.requirement: Regular supervisory reporting — annual and quarterly QRTs, RSR, own fund items, SCR/MCR calculations, ORSA results

articles.title: Solvency and Financial Condition Report (SFCR)
articles.requirement: Annual public disclosure of SFCR — business and performance, governance, risk profile, valuation methods, capital management

articles.title: SFCR — audit and board approval
articles.requirement: SFCR approved by administrative body, subject to external audit opinion on balance sheet and compliance with regulatory requirements

articles.title: Group supervision scope
articles.requirement: Group supervision applies to insurance and reinsurance undertakings that are part of a group — participation, common management

articles.title: Group risk concentration
articles.requirement: Supervisory authorities shall monitor risk concentrations at group level — reporting significant risk concentrations

articles.title: Group SCR — consolidated method
articles.requirement: Group SCR calculated on consolidated basis using either the standard formula or an approved group internal model

articles.title: Group SCR — alternative methods
articles.requirement: Where consolidated method is not appropriate, deduction and aggregation method may be used — combination of methods possible

articles.title: Governance at group level
articles.requirement: Ultimate parent shall ensure sound governance at group level — group-wide risk management, internal controls, reporting, fit and proper

articles.title: Intra-group transactions
articles.requirement: Supervisory reporting of significant intra-group transactions — type, amount, parties, risk transfer characteristics, conditions
